guarantees: Unicode general categories beginning with C are rejected

errors.unsafe_identifier: Raised when the normalized identifier contains a Unicode control, format, surrogate, private-use, or unassigned code point

compatibility.consumer_rule: A compatible replacement must preserve all guarantees, examples, rejection behavior, and exception class semantics
compatibility.breaking_change: Any removal or weakening of a guarantee, accepted rejection example, or changed exception semantics requires a new major version

revocation.signal: Set status to revoked in a later signed contract record and identify affected immutable commits
revocation.consumer_action: Block upgrades, retain the last passing immutable commit, and open external failure feedback
